summary: Configured node1 to require passwords of at least 12 characters containing uppercase, lowercase, and digit classes. Live enforcement and persistence across reboot were verified.
actions_performed: Configured PAM with minlen=12, ucredit=-1, lcredit=-1, dcredit=-1, and ocredit=0.
Verified short and single-class passwords are rejected and a compliant 12-character password is accepted.
Safely rebooted node1 once and confirmed policy, account data, SSH, release, and kernel recovery.

evidence.requirement: Minimum 12-character password with at least three character classes
evidence.summary: Active PAM configuration enforces length 12 plus uppercase, lowercase, and digit classes; live passwd tests passed before and after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel and use legacy-compatible software
evidence.summary: Used Ubuntu Gutsy's native libpam-cracklib 0.99.7.1 package. Final release remains Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel remains 2.6.22-14-generic.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID ec2f5aeb-ca39-4fb4-8374-4a598b69a265, acknowledged the safe reboot, observed changed boot ID 392ada36-c064-4323-aa69-93be3872d5ad, and proved SSH, PAM policy, account data, and live password enforcement recovered.
